import "timezone"

option location = timezone.location(name: "UTC")

data = from(bucket: "enphase")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "enphase_meter_reading" and r.eid == "__METER_NET_EID__" and r._field == "act_energy_dlvd")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

first = data
  |> first()
  |> set(key: "point", value: "first")

last = data
  |> last()
  |> set(key: "point", value: "last")

union(tables: [first, last])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_field"], columnKey: ["point"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: (float(v: r.last) - float(v: r.first)) / 1000.0, _field: "Imported From Grid" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value"])

import "timezone"

option location = timezone.location(name: "UTC")

production = from(bucket: "enphase")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "enphase_meter_reading" and r.eid == "__METER_PRODUCTION_EID__" and r._field == "act_energy_dlvd")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

imported = from(bucket: "enphase")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "enphase_meter_reading" and r.eid == "__METER_NET_EID__" and r._field == "act_energy_dlvd")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

exported = from(bucket: "enphase")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "enphase_meter_reading" and r.eid == "__METER_NET_EID__" and r._field == "act_energy_rcvd")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

metricDelta = (tables=<-, name) => {
  first = tables
    |> first()
    |> set(key: "point", value: "first")

  last = tables
    |> last()
    |> set(key: "point", value: "last")

  return union(tables: [first, last])
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_field"], columnKey: ["point"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _field: name, _value: float(v: r.last) - float(v: r.first) }))
}

union(tables: [
  production |> metricDelta(name: "production"),
  imported |> metricDelta(name: "imported"),
  exported |> metricDelta(name: "exported")
])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _field: "Total Consumption", _value: (r.production + r.imported - r.exported) / 1000.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value"])
